The '''Kira system''' was located at the center of the [[Kira Run]]. It originally contained four planets, until three of them were destroyed by an unknown cause.

==Description==
The Kira system originally contained four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], designated [[Kira I]] through [[Kira IV|IV]]. Except for Kira II, all planets were uninhabitable and had little to no resources worth of development. At one point during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the first three planets were destroyed by an unknown cataclysm. The remnants of the planets formed an unstable asteroid field which inherited the name [[Kira Prime]]. The [[Star/Legends|star's]] [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] kept most of the asteroids contained, but from time to time larger asteroids left the well and became [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] hazards.<ref name="TSK" />

==History==
[[File:Kira_Run.png|thumb|left|200px|The Kira Run.]]
The initial survey conducted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] designated the planets Kira I through IV and additionally gave the name [[Kira Prime]] to the [[Kira II|second]] - and the only inhabitable - planet. Except for Kira II, all planets were deemed unworthy of further development and the system was logged for a follow-up survey.<ref name="TSK" />

Years later a second survey found out that the first three planets of the system had been destroyed in an unknown cataclysm. The newly created asteroid field inherited the name Kira Prime from the second planet. Further research into the cause of this destruction was deemed unnecessary and the Kira system became almost forgotten.<ref name="TSK" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was under [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] control.

Around [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]]<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52||Today in History}}</ref> hyperspace [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], seeking to connect the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]] with the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]], found a reference to Kira Prime. Using the planet's coordinates, the [[Haik Expedition]] successfully established the [[Kira Run]]. Over time, this short route soon became an important link in [[Galactic economy#trade|galactic trade]] and the Kira system and important stopover point, although the asteroids of the destroyed planets still posed a small, but constant threat to all traders.<ref name="TSK" />

The system joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sometime between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. It was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />
